title: OreViewer
settings.database: Send 10+ player server seeds to the database
settings.antiAntiXrayExplained: Sends packets to the server if a dungeon floor isn't only out of cobble and mossy cobble. In response the server tells the client the real blocks. This may trigger hyper sensitive anti cheats but nobody complained about bans/kicks yet (version 2.9.0 has this feature always on and has ~2000 downloads currently). It makes the process much smoother and therefore I highly recommend leaving it on

xs.title: Ore X-ray Settings
xs.antiXray.tooltip: Renders ore boxes at seed-predicted worldgen positions regardless of the client block data. Shows buried ores that anti-xray servers fake as stone. Also works on vanilla servers.
xs.guidance.tooltip: Master switch for the on-screen guidance. When off, all end-city/structure/biome guidance scanning and rendering stops immediately for better performance. Running /ov mdc or /ov dx turns it back on automatically.
zd.title: Auto Miner Settings
zd.autoReturn: Respawn and send /back automatically on death
zd.baritoneNote: Pathing and mining are performed by Baritone (must be installed alongside). It avoids lava/water, switches tools and bridges automatically.
zd.usage: Commands: /ov zd 钻石|远古残骸|铁|金|煤|红石|青金石|铜|绿宝石 (start mining); /ov zd 停止 (stop). Pathing/mining by Baritone; auto-respawn + /back on death; auto eats; drops junk when inventory full; in the Nether mines Nether quartz to repair a Mending pickaxe when low durability.
